newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Meat rises after ratings upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Meat rises after ratings upgrade.

text.p: Nippon Meat Packers Inc shares rose on Wednesday afternoon, lifted by a ratings upgrade by a major Japanese brokerage on the previous day, brokers said.
As of 0450 GMT, Nippon Meat shares were up 100 yen or 6.71 percent at 1,590, ranking eleventh on the list of top percentage gainers on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
"The firm's rating was raised and the share price has surpassed the May 16 high of 1,480, which helped trade gain momentum," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
On Tuesday, Nomura Securities Co Ltd upgraded Nippon Meat Packers Inc to a "1" from its previous "2".

In its three-grade rating system, Nomura assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
